title: SimplyNice
description: Simply nice things for your not so simple Minecraft world!
body:
**SimplyNice is a modpack which drastically changes the game whilst also keeping that vanilla feel at the same time.**

# Features
- Enhanced terrain generation from Big Globe.
- Quick transportation with Waystones.
- See-through portals with Immersive Portals.
- Many decoration blocks with Handcrafted and Chipped.
- And many more simply nice things!
